# V0

v0 is an AI-powered web development assistant built by Vercel, designed to generate real, production-ready code for modern web applications.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/v0/.

## Actions

- **Find Chats** (read-only): Retrieve a list of chats.
- **Find Projects** (read-only): Retrieve a list of projects associated with the authenticated user.
- **V0 Chat Completions** (read-only): Generate a chat model response given a list of messages.
